title: Diagnostic value of serum miR-101-3p combined with Doppler ultrasound in polycystic ovarian syndrome: a retrospective study.

snippet: Polycystic ovarian syndrome (PCOS) is a common endocrine disorder with limited diagnostic biomarkers. miR-101-3p is implicated in endocrine regulation and ovarian function, with emerging evidence suggesting its potential as a biomarker for reproductive disorders.
